lines: Jin se mila mere dil ko chain
Koi jaane na kyun mujh se sharmaye, kaise mujhe tadpaye
couplets.en: My heart found rest in those eyes, yet who knows why they shy away and leave me longing?
Two shy eyes brim with love.

lines: Dil ye kahe, geet main tere gaaun
Tu hi sune aur main gaata jaaun
couplets.en: My heart would have me go on singing of you, with you alone to hear.

lines: Tu jo rahe saath mere, duniya ko thukraaun, tera dil behlaaun
couplets.en: Stay beside me and I would turn away from the world to gladden the heart behind those shy, loving eyes.

lines: Dar hai mujhe, tujh se bichhad na jaaun
Kho ke tujhe, milne ki raah na paaun
couplets.en: I fear that if we part, I may never find my way back to you.

lines: Aisa na ho, jab bhi tera
Aisa na ho, jab bhi tera naam labon par laaun
couplets.en: I dread what may happen each time I bring your name to my lips.

lines: Jin se mila mere dil ko chain
couplets.en: I might dissolve in tears for the eyes that once gave my heart peace.

lines: Koi jaane na kyun mujh se sharmaye, kaise mujhe tadpaye
couplets.en: Who knows why those shy eyes, so full of love, turn away and leave me aching?
